author: ShutUpThatEpic
body:
I am very sorry for advertising. However, I advertised over 2.5 years ago (Jan 31, 2014) and I have learned from my mistakes. I will never advertise on the Avicus Networks again if you would just please give me a second chance.

Sincerely, ShutUpThatEpic

replies.author: ShutUpThatEpic
replies.body:
Sorry couldn't find this appeal so I made a new one:
Hello. A while back on January 31th, 2014, I was banned for advertising. Whether it was a true or false ban I cannot remember, but what I do know is that it was a long time ago. I have learned from my mistakes and if you give me the chance to be unbanned I will never do anything disallowed again. Note: My brother who lives in the same house (same IP) as me has the accounts "EpicHacks" and "Sweat" which he occasionally lets me go on. I know that those accounts were banned for 2 weeks for chat offences, but they are not currently banned so I feel that I shouldn't still be banned on my account. (I don't use his accounts to play on avicus)

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Actually, there were two infractions issued at the same time in order to ban you. Considering that one of those accounts is my own, I'll handle this appeal. Since you've waited such a large duration of time, your infraction will be appealed and you'll be able to access our servers again. However, please remember to read the rules in the future (http://avicus.net/rules) to prevent further punishments. Enjoy the network!
 
Regards,
Rinn
